findings.text: non-blocking: `except (CrewError, OSError)` does not cover UnicodeDecodeError, which `path.read_text()` raises on a pointer holding invalid UTF-8 bytes, so that one unreadable-pointer shape escapes as a raw traceback rather than the named CrewError the evidence fragment promises for an I/O failure; the dispatch still refuses before any write, so the safety property holds and only the operator-facing message is lost.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from abd5eca84c; c767dc9647 changes reckon/crew/dispatch.py and the test (+43/-2), 7f24f669 changes only the evidence fragment (+27/-13), and nothing lands outside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_relaunch_never_touches_a_live_tree.py with its live-worker, dead-worker and spy cases plus a base arm and a logged negative control; after-arm.log records 4 passed EXIT=0 at c767dc9647, base-arm.log records 3 failed 1 passed EXIT=1 at 2754cbd2dc, and both control logs redden.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to refuse a dispatch of a run id whose worker this host still sees running before its worktree is created, and the reviewed range closes the remaining fail-open read; reckon/crew/dispatch.py:475 keeps _refuse_a_live_worker_before_the_worktree and dispatch.py:2534 calls it before run_dir(run_id).
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports status complete, the armed suite command, four green cases at c767dc9647, both controls, and a pre-existing related-suite failure it attributes to the base.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_a_relaunch_never_touches_a_live_tree.py, the evidence fragment and the figure directory; every path in the reviewed diff is inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_relaunch_never_touches_a_live_tree.py:248 fails with DID NOT RAISE CrewError when the read failure is swallowed again (negative-control-corrupt-pointer.log, 1 failed), and the clause asserted at line 222 occurs only at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:524 in the source, though no control exercises that clause alone.
justifications.evidence: after-arm.log ran at c767dc9647, one docs-only commit behind reviewed head 7f24f669, and its base arm and both control logs were read; the tree-creation control reddens the live case by DID NOT RAISE rather than the unchanged-tree assertion the done_when describes, and no log isolates the new unique-clause assertion.
justifications.fit: the guard keeps dispatch.py's local-import idiom at dispatch.py:497-498, reads like the surrounding refusal code, and carries no plan, stage or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:500-514 refuses a pointer that exists but cannot be read instead of skipping the guard, which is exactly the fail-open the plan's deliverable closes.
justifications.reuse: the change adds no definition; it reads the pointer through the owning helpers runs.pointer_path (reckon/crew/runs.py:130) and runs.read_pointer (runs.py:1043) and composes its refusal from dispatch_launch._live_worker_refusal (dispatch_launch.py:1930) and _launch_refused_by (dispatch_launch.py:1965).
justifications.scope_discipline: the reviewed diff touches only reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_a_relaunch_never_touches_a_live_tree.py and the declared evidence fragment.
